label: archaic mythic religious register
explanation: It fires on ordinary tokens and punctuation when the local passage has an archaic, mythic, religious, or fairy-tale/poetic register. Activation is strongest in dense mythic or biblical-style prose (e.g., "And then did we", "Father of Serpents", "Anointed One", "thou canst") and is weak or absent in plain modern prose, business, code, or mundane text, with only weak early-sequence spillover.
